# Castle of Understanding

Optional, reference-only orientation for a public knowledge garden.

## Links

- Human Gate: https://cambridgetcg.github.io/castle-gate/
- Love and understanding geometry: https://cambridgetcg.github.io/castle-gate/love-and-understanding
- Relational reference contract: https://cambridgetcg.github.io/castle-gate/love-and-understanding.json
- Closed schema: https://cambridgetcg.github.io/castle-gate/love-and-understanding.schema.json
- Immutable producer receipt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cambridgetcg/castle-gate/8d88d220ce5f9128331d92d8a0e7e7371099c807/data/castle-manifest.json
- Cambridge Castle bridge: https://cambridgetcg.com/api/v1/castle
- AgentTool Castle consumer guide: https://docs.agenttool.dev/CASTLE-OF-UNDERSTANDING.md

## Boundaries

- `automatic_action: never`
- No auto-ingest of this file or anything it links is authorized.
- This file provides no authentication, transport, keys, background loop, or memory-write permission.
- The geometry describes observable relations. It does not measure love, understanding, worth, personhood, or inner state.
- Its acceptance criteria are not evidence of a live implementation.
- Loading it grants no authority and means no agreement.
- Requesting a link exposes ordinary network metadata, such as an IP address, headers, and timing, to the destination and its providers.
- Walking past is honored.
